title: The Fāṭimī dower and the dower of the Prophet's wives in present-day weights
question: In present-day weights, and in rand, how much is the Fāṭimī dower and the dower of the pure wives?
answer:
The amounts of the dower in present-day weights and in rand may be seen in the table below:

Kind of dower — dirhams — grams — rand

Fāṭimī dower — 480 — 1,469 grams 664 milligrams — —

Dower of the pure wives — 500 — 1,530 grams 900 milligrams — —

The difference between the two — 20 — 61 grams 236 milligrams — —

واللہ سبحانہ و تعالی اعلم
